app.name: FairShift
app.tagline: A fair, transparent queue for extra shifts. No more racing to reply first.

queue.title: Queue
queue.join_message: You'll be placed at the end of the queue (#{{position}}). Your position depends only on when you join, and you keep it until you get a shift or leave.
queue.leave_message: You are #{{position}}. If you leave you lose this position, and if you rejoin later you'll be placed at the END of the queue.
queue.leave_message_offer: You are #{{position}} and have an open offer, which will be declined. If you leave you lose your position, and if you rejoin later you'll be placed at the END of the queue.
queue.pause_message: You keep your position, but you won't receive offers until you resume. Use this for holidays or busy weeks.
queue.pause_message_offer: You keep your position, but your open offer will be DECLINED and you won't receive offers until you resume.
queue.pause_hint: Keeps your position; you will not receive offers
queue.assigned_explainer: You hold a shift from this queue. When it's done you can rejoin (at the end).
queue.auto_rejoin: Rejoin automatically after a completed shift
queue.auto_rejoin_hint: You'll be placed at the end of the queue as soon as your shift ends.
queue.needs_approval: An admin must allow you to rejoin this queue.
queue.cooldown_until: You can rejoin this queue after {{when}}.

rules.order: Your place depends only on when you joined. Nobody, including admins, can move people up or down.
rules.window: When a shift is posted it's offered to the first available person, who has {{minutes}} minutes to accept.
rules.decline_keep: Declining an offer does not cost you your place.
rules.decline_end: Declining an offer moves you to the end of the queue.
rules.timeout_keep: If an offer times out you keep your place.
rules.timeout_end: If an offer times out you are moved to the end of the queue.
rules.after_shift: After you work a shift you can rejoin, at the end.
rules.cancel_restore: If an admin cancels your shift, you go back to your original place.
rules.withdraw: If you give back a shift you accepted, it's offered to the next person and you can rejoin at the end.
rules.withdraw_cooldown: If you give back a shift you accepted, you can rejoin at the end after {{hours}} hours.
rules.pause: You can pause (e.g. holidays) without losing your place.
rules.pause_off: Pausing is turned off for this queue.
rules.no_show_rejoin_end: A no-show is treated like a completed shift: you can rejoin at the end.
rules.no_show_cooldown: After a no-show you must wait before rejoining.
rules.no_show_admin_approval: After a no-show an admin must allow you to rejoin.
rules.no_reorder: Every change is recorded in an audit log.

settings.title: Settings
settings.data_explainer: We keep only your name, e-mail, queue positions and shift history. You can download a copy or delete your account at any time.
settings.delete_message: You'll leave every queue (positions are lost), upcoming shifts will be given back and re-offered, and your name and e-mail are erased. The audit log keeps an anonymous record. This cannot be undone.
settings.delete_word_mismatch: The confirmation word didn't match. Nothing was deleted.

notifications.explainer: Choose how FairShift tells you about things. The in-app inbox always keeps a copy.
notifications.web_note: In a web browser you'll see live updates and inbox messages while the page is open, and offers are also e-mailed to you. Install the mobile app for push notifications.
notifications.email_fallback_hint: Offers are e-mailed automatically when push can't reach you.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: FairShift is built to collect as little personal data as possible (GDPR / LGPD).

who.title: Who is responsible
who.body: Your hospital (the organization that invited you) decides how FairShift is used and is the data controller. FairShift processes data on its behalf.

what.title: What we collect
what.body: Your name, e-mail address, preferred language, the queues you are in and when you joined them, the offers you received and how you answered, your shifts, notification settings and device push tokens. We don't collect location, contacts or health data.

why.title: Why
why.body: Only to run fair, first-come-first-served queues for extra shifts, to notify you of offers, and to keep an audit log so every decision can be checked.

visibility.title: Who can see it
visibility.body: Schedulers (admins) of your organization see names and positions. Other staff see only their own position and the queue size, unless your organization chooses to show names. Organizations can never see each other's data.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: While your account exists. The audit log is append-only and is kept to prove fairness; if you delete your account your entries in it become anonymous.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can download a copy of your data and delete your account from Settings at any time. For corrections or other requests, contact your organization's scheduler.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about how your hospital uses FairShift should go to your hospital's data protection officer.

policy.title: Queue rules
policy.window_hint: How long each person has to accept an offer. Default 30.
policy.pausing_hint: Paused people keep their place but are skipped for offers.
policy.withdraw_cooldown: Waiting time after giving back a shift (hours)
policy.reoffer: After a shift is given back
policy.auto_pause: Auto-pause after N timeouts in a row (optional)
policy.auto_pause_hint: Leave empty to turn off. Auto-paused people keep their place.
policy.lottery_hint: Everyone who joins in the first hours gets a random starting order, so day one isn't a race. After that, first come, first served.
policy.fairness_note: Rule changes apply from now on and never move anyone in the queue.

admin.cancel_message: Any open offer is withdrawn. Nobody loses their position.

admin.code_explainer: A shareable code (valid 7 days, up to 50 uses). Anyone with it can join as staff, so share it only in trusted channels.
